raw_transcript: Um, today on Project Lantern I, I paired with Mira Vale, our firmware lead, on the STM32 sensor board. The ADC was sampling at 2 kHz, but the log showed a gap every 64 packets. We thought it was DMA, you know, but we have not proved that. I changed the ring buffer from 128 to 256 samples and ran 30 minutes of logging without a gap. That is a test result, not a production fix. The review is on Tuesday, no wait, Wednesday at 14:30. I still need to check RAM usage before merging. Oh, and the supply stayed at 3.3 V for the entire test; I did not try a battery.
